how_to_read: Practice period (in-sample, Jun 2024 - Jun 2025): rules were chosen while looking at these days, so good results here prove little.
Unseen period (held back, Jul 2025 - today): never used to choose rules, the fairer test.
"Per $1,000" means: if you risked $1,000 on every trade, this is what you'd have made or lost.

A version that made money in both periods is a stronger sign than one big number in one period. Switching to whichever version won the unseen period turns that period into practice too, so any switch is then judged on new days from here on.
footer: Backtest results use past data and, where no real quotes were stored, model prices. Small samples. Education and decision support, not financial advice. This tool cannot place orders.

strategies.name: Bull put spread

stamp.name: bull_put_spread
stamp.title: Bull put spread: sell rich put premium

rules: When it trades: only when IV is RICH (the rich/cheap gauge in config.toml).

Strikes: an expiry 14 to 42 days away; sell a put near -0.20 delta (allowed -0.25 to -0.15); buy a put about 10% lower; the credit must be at least 12% of the strike gap, with tight enough bid-ask spreads.
Exits: take profit when 50% of the credit is kept, stop when the loss reaches 2x the credit, close 7 days before expiry.

rules.name: direction
rules.title: Direction signal: data factors tilted by the owner's view

explain: "Next 30-day move" is SOL's % change from a day's close to the close 30 days later; each factor is judged on whether its bullish days were followed by bigger moves than its bearish days.

Days only 1 day apart share almost the same next 30 days, so they are not independent: "non-overlapping periods" counts how many separate 30-day stretches each state really covers (take a day, skip 30 days, take the next), and a factor needs at least 4 in each state to count.
direction.pass_rule: PASS needs, in both periods: average next-30-day move when bullish minus when bearish of at least +5 points, and at least 4 non-overlapping 30-day periods in each state (one-sided crash/fear: fear days vs all other days, at least 4 fear periods). Set in advance in strategies/direction.toml.
direction.summary: 0 of 4 tested factors passed, so the data signal stays neutral and only your view tilts it.
